data.current_summary: Clean up after a bridge Checkout Session completes

Intended to be called from your checkout.session.completed webhook handler. Idempotent—safe to call multiple times. Returns the updated session details.

data.current_summary: Add tax to a Stripe Checkout Session
data.current_description: One call for a merchant who builds their own session: Sphere reads the cart back off it, prices the buyer's address, and attaches the rates. The session must still be open. Nothing is stored.
data.description_suggestion: Calculates and attaches tax rates to a Stripe Checkout Session for merchants who create sessions independently. Sphere retrieves the cart items from the session, calculates tax based on the buyer's address, and attaches the computed tax rates to session line items. The session must be in an open state. No data is persisted—this is a read-only calculation operation. Returns the session with updated tax rates applied.

data.current_description: Create an invoice (type: debit) or a credit note (type: credit), as a pending draft or finalized in one call. A finalized request runs the tax engine and returns subtotal, tax and total. Re-posting the same external_id updates the transaction.
data.description_suggestion: Creates a transaction (invoice or credit note) with optional immediate tax calculation and finalization. Specify type as 'debit' for invoices or 'credit' for credit notes. Set status to 'draft' for pending transactions or 'finalized' to immediately run the tax engine and compute subtotal, tax, and total. The external_id serves as an idempotency key—re-posting with the same external_id updates the existing transaction (merge behavior). Returns the created or updated transaction with calculated tax details if finalized.
